component_notes.Alert: Use polite status announcements except urgent error messages, which are assertive.
component_notes.Button: Loading and disabled controls cannot activate; icon-only usage needs an accessible name.
component_notes.FormField: Associate label, hint, and error content with its child input using stable IDs.
component_notes.Modal: Provide title labeling, Escape close, initial focus, a Tab focus loop, close-button naming, and focus restoration.
component_notes.TextInput: Keep native input types and attributes; invalid state must be expressible without color alone.

consolidation_rule: Support every distinct visual intent and size observed for each canonical component; states are behavior, not separate variants.
